about_the_game:
Welcome to AIVX PUSH

Dive into a brand new arcade puzzle game with addictive gameplay, pulsing music, and mesmerizing visuals! 

Gameplay

In AIVX PUSH, you push blocks up from a tray which moves with the music. Form squares to make fuses, which clear all connected blocks. Build up your multiplier, and create Chains, Cascades, Massives, and more, to increase your score or complete challenges. It's deceptively simple, yet deep and challenging to master.

Features (in development, subject to change)

  • Join the party! In Arcade Live mode, everyone competes for a new high score every two minutes. Restrict it to just your friends, or take on the entire world.

  • Hone your skills! Progress through 40+ hours of content in Challenge mode, a collection of varied, ever-increasing challenges which will take you all the way from Novice to Grandmaster. 

  • Represent your team! Any player can create a team and allow others to join. Earn points for your favorite streamer or influencer, and push them up the rankings.

  • Whichever way you play, you'll unlock new skins, backgrounds, and more to customize the game and make it your own.

  • From the award-winning designer of the cult classic puzzler Shibuya.

  • AIVX PUSH is the first game created in AIVX ENGINE, a new type of generative 3D engine which builds stunning procedural visuals in real time.
